intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Two damp maps lie on the stones at the water’s edge, pinned down with pebbles. They disagree about everything.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “This is a surface map. The sea is a blue patch labeled ‘Sea.’”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Ours, meanwhile, shows the land as a blank patch labeled ‘Dry. Here be cows.’”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “So both sides gave up at the shoreline.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Each mapmaker drew home in exquisite detail, and the other side as a rumor.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her tail flicks a little water onto the blank land, as if to see what grows.

options.labelText: “Teach me one current. Just one. I’ll draw it in.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “One. Very well. We start with the shy one.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She guides your finger in a thin blue line across the empty sea. It is the first thing on that map that’s right.

options.labelText: “Let’s merge them into one proper map. I’m good at merges.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: In the blank land of her map, she adds a small note: *Wants to merge the sea.*
